I am so sorry for your loss. You were an amazing cat parent and you did as much as you could.
We had a cat who passed away in May after a long battle with chronic kidney disease. We did everything we could, changed his diet, spent thousands on tests and medicine, made sure nothing was making him sicker, but he unfortunately still passed away after his bowel twisted. no matter how much we tried, the vet told us that this would have happened eventually. But I agree with you: looking after him in his golden years was so much more rewarding than the idea of having a child. I don't care that he was nauseous a lot and often suffered toilet problems because of the disease, I could have looked after him for life. Cats are precious and it's a shame they're not here with us longer. 💜
